newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Avantel receives 13-year $481 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Avantel receives 13-year $481 mln loan.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Avantel said on Monday that it has received a 13-year loan worth $481 million from the United States Export-Import Bank and the Export Development Corp.
Avantel SA is a joint venture between MCI Communications Corp and Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival, Mexico's largest banking group.
The Export Development Corp is the Canadian export development bank.
Avantal said the loan will be used for investment purposes.

"This is the first time that the (U.S.) EX-IM Bank has authorized a commercial loan guarantee for a telecommunications company, using the financing structure for projects. Moreover, it is one of the most important authorized by the EDC in Mexico," Jose Maria Zubiria, Avantel director of financing, said.
The structure of the operation is based exclusively on the expected cash flow of the company.
Bank of America acted as structuring agent, and ABN-AMRO, Banamex and Swiss Bank acted as co-agents.
